fields.description: Turns on accounts, licenses, groups and document groups. The connection itself is in Microsoft 365 Settings.
fields.label: Enabled
Sync Licenses, Groups and Accounts Daily

fields.description: During sync, employees whose email (field below) already has a Microsoft 365 account get a Microsoft 365 Account record.
fields.label: Link Existing Microsoft 365 Accounts

fields.description: Python expression on the Employee, e.g. doc.status == "Active". Also used to enable the account again for a returning employee.
fields.label: Create When

fields.description: One Employee field per line; the account is not created while any is empty.
fields.label: Required Employee Fields

fields.description: Verified domain of the tenant, e.g. example.com.
fields.label: Email Domain

fields.description: Tokens: {first}, {middle}, {last}, {first_initial}. {last} starts with the letters below and grows one letter at a time until the address is free in ERPNext and Microsoft 365.
fields.label: Address Pattern
Letters of Last Name to Start With

fields.description: One per line, e.g. al, el. Dropped from the last name when written as a separate word or with a hyphen (Al Harbi, Al-Harbi → harbi).
fields.label: Name Prefixes to Drop

fields.description: Creates (or links) an ERPNext User with the new email and sets it on the Employee's User ID if empty — for Microsoft sign-in to ERPNext.
fields.label: Create ERPNext User for the New Email

fields.description: Two-letter country code (e.g. SA, IN, AE). Microsoft requires it before a license can be assigned.
fields.label: Usage Location

fields.description: Employee field holding the manager (an Employee). Empty = don't set the manager.
fields.label: Manager Field
Update Microsoft 365 When the Employee Changes

fields.description: Employee field (or path like department.department_name) → Microsoft 365 user property. Name fields are always sent.
fields.label: Field Mapping

fields.description: Rehire: enables the account, assigns the rule licenses and groups and sends a new password.
fields.label: Enable Again When the Create Condition Matches

fields.description: 0 = never delete. Deleted users stay in Microsoft's recycle bin for 30 days.
fields.label: Delete Disabled Accounts After (Days)
Send Welcome Email with the Password

fields.description: Microsoft 365: sent by Microsoft Graph from the mailbox below; the password is not stored anywhere. ERPNext Email: uses the site's outgoing email account.
fields.label: Send Through

fields.description: e.g. it@example.com. In Test Mode any address of the fake tenant works, e.g. it.admin@<your domain>.
fields.label: Sender Mailbox

fields.description: Optional. Jinja with doc (Employee), email, password, login_url. Empty = built-in message.
fields.label: Email Template
